description: This file contains utility functions for the ERPNext system, including updating doctype fields based on certain criteria and retrieving site information such as default company, domain, and activation level.

methods.name: update_doctypes()
methods.description: Updates DocType fields where fieldname includes 'description' and fieldtype is 'Text' or 'Small Text', changing them to 'Text Editor' and saving the DocType.

methods.name: get_site_info(site_info)
methods.description: Retrieves site-related information including default company, domain, and activation level, returning them in a dictionary.
